objective: Perform the bounded read-only re-audit of repaired design candidate 67dd1a5fbaa35ebd3679d50d3f21ffbdcb70b317. Confirm the prior mechanical gate's only blocker is closed: all 40 content/design/m1_phase_cards.json records must map one-to-one and in order to the 40 card objects in scripts/data/stage_content_database.gd with exact decoded display_name and kind, including Japanese text, Traditional/Simplified glyph choice, and punctuation; docs/content/m1-design-freeze.md must contain every exact repaired phase name. Confirm the repair changed exactly 24 JSON display_name values and the corresponding 24 markdown index names, with no ID, owner, kind, stream, fingerprint, timing, warning, emitter, movement, failure, Normal, Hard, score-route, stage-beat, plan, or runtime drift. Reconfirm the original approved counts: six stages, 108 beats, 40 phases, 26 spells, 14 nonspells, 40 unique IDs/streams/fingerprints. Do not launch Godot, edit files, or repeat subjective design review. Return GATE: APPROVE or GATE: REPAIR with exact evidence.
acceptance_commands: $cards=Get-Content -Raw content/design/m1_phase_cards.json|ConvertFrom-Json; $source=Get-Content -Raw scripts/data/stage_content_database.gd; $pattern='\{\s*"name":\s*"[^"]+"\s*,\s*"hp":\s*\d+\s*,\s*"time":\s*\d+\s*,\s*"pattern":\s*"[^"]+"\s*,\s*"kind":\s*"[^"]+"\s*\}'; $records=[regex]::Matches($source,$pattern); if($records.Count -ne 40 -or $cards.phases.Count -ne 40){throw 'Expected 40 cards'}; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){ $record=$records[$i].Value|ConvertFrom-Json; $phase=$cards.phases[$i]; if($phase.display_name -cne $record.name -or $phase.kind -cne $record.kind){throw "Mismatch at $i $($phase.id)"} }; Write-Host 'M1_CARD_NAMES=pass'

$cards=Get-Content -Raw content/design/m1_phase_cards.json|ConvertFrom-Json; $doc=Get-Content -Raw docs/content/m1-design-freeze.md; if(@($cards.phases|Where-Object kind -eq spell).Count -ne 26 -or @($cards.phases|Where-Object kind -eq nonspell).Count -ne 14 -or @($cards.phases.id|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 40 -or @($cards.phases.structure_fingerprint|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 40 -or @($cards.phases.deterministic_random_stream_id|Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 40){throw 'Identity/count regression'}; foreach($phase in $cards.phases){if(-not $doc.Contains([string]$phase.display_name)){throw "Markdown missing $($phase.id)"}}; Write-Host 'M1_CONTENT_REAUDIT=pass'
output_requirements: Begin summary with GATE: APPROVE or GATE: REPAIR and state that no Godot command was run
Report 40/40 exact card-name/kind mapping and the exact repaired count of 24
Confirm counts, IDs, streams, fingerprints, stage beats, and all non-name fields did not drift
Report all four acceptance command exit codes and zero changed files
List any remaining blocker with exact phase ID and field
